**Big, and four zones must not be renamed.** `1082` lines in `94` files.

| Zone | Lines | Call |
|---|---|---|
| `services` JS names | 900 | Safe to rename |
| `services` SQL strings | 125 | Freeze. Column stays until a migration renames it |
| `migrations` | 61 | Freeze. Applied history, breaks the down step |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | Freeze. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites it |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Freeze. Public contract, breaking change |
| `lib` | 5 | Half. See below |

In [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js#L8) rename only the left key. The right value `'account_id'` is the public wire name.

Next: ask them to confirm a blind find-and-replace is off the table.
